judgement.why_this_decision: Event 003 asked whether the landlord was happy for a contractor to be sent. Event 007 says Felix agrees, 'when convenient'. That only qualifies timing and sets no cost cap or condition, so it counts as approval for attendance under the 'have a contractor look at it' rule. A reply signed with a different name (Felix vs Grace) on the landlord's thread is normal. Assigning needs a contractor name, and none is in the records, so a human has to pick from the panel.
